name: Oracle (ORCL)
teaser: Watchlist for new money. Oracle's AI build costs up to $95 billion this year; at $115.16 the price is close to my Base of $120.86, with a buy range of $59.59 to $82.91.
llms: Oracle Corporation (ORCL) sells databases and business software and is building one of the largest AI cloud infrastructure businesses (OCI). Valued with a ten-year free cash flow model after stock-based pay, depreciation and own capital spending, with excess customer prepayments treated like debt and a forward EV/EBIT cross-check on fiscal 2029. Capex was $28.5 billion in one quarter, up to $95 billion planned for fiscal 2027, with $288 billion of data center leases not yet started; the price implies about $164 billion of fiscal 2030 revenue against a $225 billion target. Bear $42.71, Base $120.86, Bull $240.94. Verdict Hold at $115.16 (November 5, 2026 close), buy range $59.59 to $82.91, maximum buy price $59.59.
